intake.matter_summary: Defense of a solo practitioner in a disciplinary proceeding brought by the Meridian Office of Lawyer Conduct alleging commingling and delayed disbursement of client settlement funds, inadequate trust records, and failure to communicate with a second client.
intake.referral_source: referral from the county bar association's lawyers-assistance contact

conflicts_check.notes: Winterhalt is the firm's client. No current or former firm client is adverse; neither Marchetti, Osei, nor their counsel has any prior relationship with Ellingboe & Ravndal. No conflict identified.

time_entries.narrative: Initial client interview with Winterhalt; overview of petition and personal circumstances.
Run conflicts check; open matter; prepare and send engagement letter.
Review Petition for Disciplinary Action, Marchetti and Osei complaints, and MOLC investigation file.
Assemble bank records; review reconstructed trust-account reconciliation with bookkeeper.
Draft preliminary case-analysis memorandum on violations, admissions, and mitigation.
Draft Respondent's Answer to the Petition.
Client counseling session on candor duties, disclosure strategy, and realistic sanction outcomes.
Legal research on sanction factors and the commingling/misappropriation distinction; research memo.
Witness preparation and interview of former legal assistant Nadia Fenwick.
Draft Respondent's pre-hearing brief on sanction and mitigation.
Negotiation with disciplinary counsel regarding a possible stipulation for discipline.
Revise pre-hearing brief; assemble mitigation exhibits and remediation record.
Prepare for hearing before the LPRB panel and referee; outline direct testimony.
Moot oral argument on sanction; refine responses to anticipated panel questions.
Finalize mitigation exhibits and character reference letters for the hearing.
Attend disciplinary hearing before the referee; present mitigation and argument.
